description: Telangana government is actively engaging with US firms founded by Telugus to invest in the proposed Artificial Intelligence City in Hyderabad. The plan aims to democratize the investment process and promote tech growth in the region.
body_lead: HYDERABAD: Chief minister A Revanth Reddy's plan for an Artificial Intelligence City, coming up in the surroundings of Hyderabad, will have a âTelugu touch' along with an ITServe building with a majority of the companies founded by Telugu-origin people in the United States being roped in to invest in the project. The state govt is actively engaged with several AI product development firms and startups floated by Telugus in the US to invest in the proposed AI City.
